name: Accessiy by CodeConfig – Accessibility Widgets for ADA, EAA & WCAG Compliance
author: CodeConfig

sections.description:
Accessiy by CodeConfig is an accessibility plugin, designed to enhance website accessibility for all users, including those with visual, auditory, motor, or cognitive disabilities. With a one-click accessibility setup, Accessiy by CodeConfig ensures your site meets WCAG 2.1, ADA, and European Accessibility Act (EAA) accessibility standards. This lightweight accessibility solution, built without jQuery, delivers top-tier accessibility performance and integrates seamlessly with any WordPress theme. Accessiy, powered by CodeConfig’s accessibility toolkit, empowers site owners to create an inclusive, accessibility-first digital experience.

👁️More Features | 👑Get Pro | 📄Documentations | ⏯️Video Tutorials | 🎧Support

Why Choose Accessiy by CodeConfig for your Website?

Accessiy by CodeConfig is offering a no-code accessibility solution to make your site universally accessible. Key accessibility benefits include:
– One-Click Accessibility Setup: Activate accessibility features instantly for immediate accessibility improvements.
– WCAG & EAA Accessibility Compliance: Supports global accessibility standards like WCAG 2.1 and EAA for inclusive accessibility.
– Customizable Accessibility Toolbar: Tailor accessibility icon, size, position, and branding for seamless accessibility integration.
– Lightweight Accessibility Design: Optimized for speed with no jQuery, ensuring fast accessibility performance.
– Multilingual Accessibility Support: Offers accessibility in 35+ languages, including all EU accessibility-compliant languages.
– GDPR-Compliant Accessibility: No user data collection; accessibility settings stored in localStorage for privacy-focused accessibility.
– Responsive Accessibility Design: Accessibility optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
– Accessibility Statement Generator: Create a compliance-ready accessibility statement to showcase your accessibility commitment.

Why Is Accessibility Important?

Accessibility is essential for ethical and legal reasons. Website owners are responsible for ensuring accessibility compliance with WCAG and EAA standards, making accessibility features critical for inclusivity. Accessibility improves user experience, boosts SEO, and widens your audience, making accessibility a smart business choice. Accessiy by CodeConfig simplifies accessibility compliance, helping you meet rising accessibility regulations.

Core Accessibility Features

Accessiy by CodeConfig’s accessibility toolkit provides comprehensive accessibility enhancements for WordPress sites:

Accessibility Profiles

✅ Motor Impaired Support (PRO): Profile designed to assist users with motor difficulties for easier navigation

✅ Blind & Low Vision Support (FREE): Profile providing screen reader and accessibility tools for visually impaired users

✅ Dyslexia Friendly (FREE): Profile optimized with fonts and styles for dyslexia-friendly reading

✅ Cognitive & Learning Support (PRO): Profile with simplified layouts and readability options for cognitive and learning accessibility

✅ ADHD Friendly Mode (PRO): Profile offering focused reading modes and reduced distractions for users with ADHD

📝 Content Accessibility Adjustments [▶️Video Overview]

✅ Bigger Text (FREE): Boost accessibility with larger font sizes for improved readability

✅ Line Height (FREE): Enhance accessibility by adjusting line spacing for clearer text

✅ Text Alignment (FREE): Improve accessibility with left-aligned or justified text options

✅ Readable Font (FREE): Switch to dyslexia-friendly fonts for accessibility-focused readability

🔍 Text Magnifier (PRO): Hover-to-magnify text for advanced accessibility visibility

🔗 Highlight Links (FREE): Emphasize links to enhance accessibility in navigation

🖱️ Cursor Customization (FREE): Enlarge or style cursors for accessibility-friendly visibility

🔡 Letter Spacing (FREE): Manage letter spacing for enhanced readability

⌨️ Keyboard Navigation (FREE): Use keyboard to navigate your website

🧭 Orientation Accessibility Adjustments

📑 Page Structure (PRO): Highlight content structure for better accessibility in navigation flow

🗣️ Screen Reader Support (PRO): Enable text-to-speech accessibility for visually impaired users

📖 Reading Mask (PRO): Dim surrounding content to focus on specific accessibility-enhanced sections

🗺️ Site Map (PRO): Display a structured accessibility view of page elements for intuitive navigation

🖼️ Hide Images (PRO): Reduce visual clutter by removing images

⏸️ Pause Animations (FREE): Stop animations to improve accessibility for motion-sensitive users

🔇 Mute Sounds (PRO): Disable audio for distraction-free accessibility

📏 Reading Line (FREE): Add a horizontal guide for accessibility-guided reading

🔲 Outline Focus (FREE): Highlight headings and focusable elements for accessibility clarity

🏷️ Highlight Titles (FREE): Highlight your website titles with one click

🎨 Color Accessibility Adjustments

⚫ Grayscale Mode (PRO): Convert pages to black-and-white for accessibility-friendly contrast

🌗 Contrast Adjustment (PRO): Optimize accessibility with enhanced contrast for visual impairments

🔄 Invert Colors (PRO): Invert colors for improved visibility

💡 Brightness Control (FREE): Adjust brightness for tailored viewing comfort

🌈 Saturation Adjustment (PRO): Modify color intensity for optimized visuals

📊 Analytics

📌 Enable Analytics: One-click toggle to start tracking which features users interact with most

📈 Display Analytics: View usage data based on selected timeframes (All Time, Last 30 Days)

📊 Chart Type: Choose from 13 different chart types to visualize usage trends effectively

⭐ Uses Features: Displays the top 7 most used features along with a full list of all accessibility tools and their usage counts

📊 Statement Generator

📝 Generate Accessibility Statement
Easily create a professional accessibility statement for your website to demonstrate compliance and transparency

Multilingual Accessibility Support

Accessiy by CodeConfig ensures accessibility across 35+ languages, including:
🇬🇧 English, 🇩🇪 Deutsch, 🇪🇸 Español, 🇫🇷 Français, 🇮🇹 Italiano, 🇵🇱 Polski, 🇸🇪 Svenska, 🇫🇮 Suomi, 🇵🇹 Português, 🇷🇴 Română, 🇸🇮 Slovenščina, 🇸🇰 Slovenčina, 🇳🇱 Nederlands, 🇩🇰 Dansk, 🇬🇷 Ελληνικά, 🇨🇿 Čeština, 🇭🇺 Magyar, 🇱🇹 Lietuvių, 🇱🇻 Latviešu, 🇪🇪 Eesti, 🇭🇷 Hrvatski, 🇮🇪 Gaeilge, 🇧🇩 বাংলা, 🇮🇳 हिन्दी, 🇧🇬 Български and more, for global accessibility reach.

24/7 Support

Our dedicated accessibility support team is available 24/7 for accessibility-related installation, customization, or troubleshooting. Contact us at Support Portal for accessibility assistance.

Accessibility Customization Options

  • Enable/disable specific accessibility features for tailored accessibility.
  • Customize accessibility toolbar icon, title, and position (desktop, tablet, mobile).
  • Adjust accessibility-focused dark mode and cursor colors.
  • Save or reset accessibility preferences for user-friendly accessibility.
  • Show/hide accessibility plugin on specific pages or templates.

Contribute

Accessiy by CodeConfig is an open source project. You can view the full sources (unminified JS) and contribute to the project on GitLab: https://gitlab.com/jakirul/codeconfig-accessibility

🔥 WHAT’S NEXT 🔥

Consider checking out our other products:

📦 File Manager For Dropbox – File Manager for Dropbox lets you connect your cloud storage to your site so you can upload, embed, and share files without touching your server space.

📂 Integration Google Drive – Easily use any Google Drive files to WordPress with awesome gallery, slider carousel, file browser, and embed documents.

🛒 Essential Addons for WooCommerce – Packed with 14+ must-have features to supercharge your WooCommerce store.

🌙 Dusky Dark Mode – A beautifully designed dark mode plugin for WordPress that enhances user experience day and night.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the accessibility plugin to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload or install it directly from the WordPress Plugins directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins page
  3. Go to Accessiy by CodeConfig Settings in your dashboard to set up your accessibility options.

Video Tutorial
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills for Accessiy by CodeConfig?

No! Accessiy by CodeConfig offers a no-code accessibility interface with a one-click accessibility setup for all users

Is Accessiy by CodeConfig an accessibility-optimized, lightweight plugin?

Yes! Built without jQuery, Accessiy by CodeConfig ensures fast accessibility performance and compatibility with all WordPress themes

Does Accessiy by CodeConfig support WCAG and EAA accessibility compliance?

Yes, Accessiy by CodeConfig aligns with WCAG 2.1 and EAA accessibility standards to meet global accessibility requirements

Which languages support Accessiy by CodeConfig?

Accessiy by CodeConfig provides accessibility in 35+ languages, including English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Swedish, and more

What accessibility support is available?

Our 24/7 accessibility support team is ready to help at codeconfig.dev/contact

Does Accessiy by CodeConfig work with any WordPress theme or page builder?

Yes, Accessiy by CodeConfig is fully compatible with all WordPress themes and popular page builders like Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, and Beaver Builder

Can I customize which accessibility features appear for users?

Absolutely — you can enable or disable specific accessibility tools based on your site’s needs

Is Accessiy by CodeConfig mobile-friendly?

Yes, Accessiy by CodeConfig is fully responsive and works seamlessly across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices

Does Accessiy by CodeConfig slow down my website?

Not at all — Accessiy by CodeConfig is lightweight and optimized for performance, ensuring no noticeable impact on site speed

Can I track which accessibility tools visitors use most?

Yes! Accessiy by CodeConfig includes built-in analytics so you can see which features your visitors engage with most

Is there a free version of Accessiy by CodeConfig?

Yes, Accessiy by CodeConfig offers free accessibility features with optional PRO upgrades for advanced tools

How often is Accessiy by CodeConfig updated?

We release regular updates to improve accessibility features, security, and compatibility with the latest WordPress versions

Can I use Accessiy by CodeConfig on client websites?

Yes, you can install and use Accessiy by CodeConfig on multiple client websites, making it perfect for developers and agencies

Does Accessiy by CodeConfig help with ADA compliance?

Yes, Accessiy by CodeConfig helps you get closer to ADA and other global accessibility compliance standards by providing key accessibility enhancements
